description.p: A lightweight image viewer in the spirit of IrfanView: opens instantly, shows pixels 1:1 on any display scaling, steps through folders with the wheel or arrow keys, and understands the formats people actually have, including camera raw files, HEIF/AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP, PSD and PDF.
Includes exposure adjustment for raw files, region selection with crop and copy, metadata/EXIF inspection with map links, configurable mouse controls, and saving to common formats.
